answer: Because the vertex cliff is fixed at deposit and written down in the ferrous ledger, the quartz audit publishes how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 12 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. That is 23 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
